functions.name: PROMPT
functions.description: Ask the configured OpenPlugin model a prompt, optionally grounded in a range.

functions.name: MAP
functions.description: Map each row of a range through an instruction. Returns one column.

parameters.name: instruction
parameters.description: What to do to each row

functions.name: EXTRACT
functions.description: Extract fields described by a comma-separated schema from a range.

functions.name: TRANSLATE
functions.description: Translate a cell or range into a target language. Optional source language; omit to auto-detect.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Destination language name or code (for example Spanish or fr)

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional source language; omit to auto-detect
